steps.title: Prepare lysis mixture
steps.instruction: If DNAse I is not added by the robot, add DNAse I to the lysis buffer at 1 µL per mL of bacterial media; then load the lysis buffer (with DNAse I if applicable) into the reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the appropriate volume of lysis buffer into each well of the sample plate containing bacterial media.

steps.title: Incubate for cell lysis
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and shake the sample plate at room temperature for 10–20 min to allow lysis.

steps.title: Resuspend paramagnetic beads
steps.instruction: If the ‘Pause robot operation to allow user to vortex magnetic beads’ parameter is on, pause and vortex the bead suspension to fully resuspend.

steps.title: Add beads and NaCl
steps.instruction: Add the nickel‑linked paramagnetic beads to each well; add NaCl if desired; then mix the contents by pipetting the number of mixes specified in the parameters.

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting the specified number of times

steps.title: Bind beads to magnet
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for the duration set by the ‘Magnet engagement time for bead binding’ parameter, allowing beads to collect.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: While the magnet is engaged, aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Add wash buffer (optionally containing NaCl) to each well, mix, re‑engage the magnet for the specified time, then remove and discard the wash supernatant. Repeat this wash cycle the number of times defined by the user.

steps.title: Elute proteins
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet, remove the final wash supernatant, then add elution buffer (or, if running a gel, add SDS buffer instead of elution buffer). After a brief incubation, transfer the eluate to the destination plate (which may be on a temperature module if used).

substeps.instruction: Add elution buffer or SDS buffer
